description: On the table there’s a pile of multicolored beads in the middle-left and a red string leading toward a tape dispenser on the right. The right hand holds the red string near its free end and slides a bead along it, while the left hand reaches into the bead pile to pick up another bead and then moves toward the string as if to thread it; both hands alternately pinch, release, and reposition the string and beads so they travel up and down the cord.
